title: Definitions.
bodyText:
As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

"Council" means the environmental advisory council established in this chapter.

"Director" means the director of the office of planning and sustainable development.

"Office" means the office of planning and sustainable development.
bodyHtml:
§341-2  Definitions.  As used in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires:

     "Council" means the environmental advisory council established in this chapter.

     "Director" means the director of the office of planning and sustainable development.

     "Office" means the office of planning and sustainable development. [L 1970, c 132, pt of §1; am L 2006, c 75, §12; am L 2021, c 152, §10 and c 153, §9]
